narrative.overview:
The site is set like a corporate graphics standards manual. White paper pages hold the content; full-bleed cobalt divider pages open each numbered part. Everything is numbered (1.0, 1.1 to 1.6, 2.1, 3.1, 4.1), every section sits under a 2px black rule, and the work is stated as standards with correct and incorrect usage beside them. Black ink, one grotesk, square corners, no shadows.

Density is that of a printed reference: long horizontal rows separated by 1px hairlines, a numeric gutter on the left, text that runs wide but stops at a measure. Colour is almost binary: paper and ink carry the pages, cobalt is the only accent and is used either as a whole surface (divider pages, the hero cover, the closing contact page) or as small marks (section numbers, markers, links, the active nav rule). Red appears only as the "incorrect" signal.

The world is light-only by design. There is no dark theme and `color-scheme` is pinned to light.
keyCharacteristics: Paper pages and full-bleed cobalt divider pages, alternating as the manual's parts.
Section numbering on every heading, nav item and list row.
2px black rules open sections; 1px hairlines separate rows.
Hairline 12-column layout guides drawn on the contents page.
Correct (cobalt, check) and incorrect (red, cross) usage panels.
One family, Schibsted Grotesk, from 400 to 900; section numbers sit inside their headings in pale cobalt, never as standalone glyphs.
Square corners everywhere; depth comes only from rules and colour fields.

rules.name: The Surface Or Mark Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is either the entire page (a divider, cover, page head or close band, full bleed with a 2px ink rule on top) or a small mark on paper. It is never a tinted card, panel, or background block in the middle of a paper page.

rules.name: The Red Means Wrong Rule
rules.body: Red is only the incorrect-usage panel and error states. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Every Heading Is Numbered Rule
rules.body: A section heading, a sheet heading and a list row carry their manual number (2.3, 4.1) in cobalt or mute. A heading without a number is a page title, not a section.

rules.name: The Weight Not Face Rule
rules.body: Never add a second family. Contrast comes from 400 against 800/900.

rules.name: The Rules Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: If something needs separating, draw a rule. Never a shadow, blur, or tonal gradient fill. The repeating-gradient technique that draws the 1px layout guides is a drawing tool for hairlines, not a permission for gradients.

dos: **Do** open every section with either a cobalt divider page or a sheet head under a 2px ink rule, and number it.
**Do** keep cobalt (#1f3fd1) to whole surfaces or small marks; text on it is white or pale cobalt.
**Do** separate rows with 1px hairlines and a fixed numeric gutter (52px, 40px on phones).
**Do** set forms as paper frames with a 2px ink border and a black caption bar, even on cobalt.
**Do** use the four authored icons (2.25 stroke, square caps) in `currentColor`.
**Do** keep motion to colour shifts, the nav bar growing from the left, and arrow nudges, all on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and all off under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** round a corner or add a shadow.
**Don't** fill a surface with a gradient; the repeating-gradient hairline guides are the only gradient, and they draw lines.
**Don't** set tags as pills or chips; they are slash-separated text.
**Don't** use red for anything but incorrect usage and errors.
**Don't** add a second typeface or a dark theme.
**Don't** place a cobalt tinted box inside a paper page.
